alt: Real ChatGPT /oral execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /oral Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive oral-exam practice widget about training versus inference. Show one question at a time, an answer field, expected-answer reveal and next/back. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Write a concise distinction that could be expanded in an oral answer.
Reveal the expected answer and compare the key concepts.
Advance to the second oral-exam question.
Explain why using a new definition does not establish weight updates.
Compare the explanation with the chapter-grounded expected answer.
Advance to the third oral-exam question.
Summarize how prediction error guides parameter updates in pretraining.
Reveal the expected account of the training mechanism.
Go Back to verify that the earlier written answer is retained.
Return to the third question and its stored explanation.
Explain the purpose of keeping the model fixed while varying the input.
Reveal the expected reasoning for the controlled comparison.
Distinguish retrieval from parameter updates and ordinary model calculations.
Reveal and compare the final expected answer.
Restart the oral-practice set for another attempt.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
